title: Once (bc30)
synopsis:
A modern-day musical about a busker and an immigrant and their eventful week in Dublin. 


A vacuum repairman moonlights as a street musician and hopes for his big break. One day a Czech immigrant, who earns a living selling flowers, approaches him with the news that she is also an aspiring singer-songwriter. The pair decide to collaborate, and the songs that they compose reflect the story of their blossoming love.

 

Following the screenings on 1 November, musician Olivier Cong and a surprise guest will busk outside the cinema at 3:15pm and 5:00pm in tribute to the film and Glen Hansard.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
一位在都柏林街頭彈結他唱歌的中年唱作人，街頭表演時認識了一位懂彈鋼琴的年輕母親，她是來自捷克的女移民。兩位各懷心事的音樂人在相處中漸對對方萌生好感，並藉音樂互相支持。最後唱作人決定離開都柏林前，與女移民及其他街頭表演者走進錄音室，錄一張屬於他們的唱片。愛爾蘭搖滾樂團 The Frames 主唱兼吉他手葛倫韓薩主演，他與女拍檔瑪可塔·伊爾格洛娃共同唱作的Falling Slowly更奪奧斯卡最佳原創歌曲，韓薩今年不幸因車禍辭世，此曲此情成追憶。 

11月1日下午3點15分及5點，音樂人Olivier Cong聯同神秘嘉賓將在戲院外busking，向此電影及葛倫韓薩致敬。

cast_lang.zh_hk: 葛倫韓薩、瑪可塔伊爾格洛娃
